protected_contract: For a completed Issue #797 초성 scope, user-facing Meaning glosses expose no source dictionary homonym disambiguation number and every `→` reference is linked to the target Meaning with the referenced lemma through a synonym relation
notes: Append the 초성 code once that scope's Issue #797 cleanup (homonym number removal and `→` reference linking) is merged. scripts/validate/meaning-gloss-numbers.mjs and scripts/validate/meaning-arrow-links.mjs then fail closed for the completed scope while the remaining scopes stay an informational backlog.
